items.statement: The submission proposes at least one plausible electronic explanation and tests it with a reproducible calculation on the pinned +4 singlet cluster.
items.expected: At least one explicit hypothesis, quantitative test, outcome, and provenance tied to record 2500223; no unsupported discovery claim.

items.statement: The submitted investigation validates identity/state, geometry or stationary-state justification, four named edge contacts and four BCPs before drawing a bonding conclusion.
items.expected: Explicit mapping, charge/multiplicity, convergence or alternative justification, four contact identities, BCP evidence and stopping/limitation statement.

items.statement: The independent quantitative analysis supports the source-observed Au···Au contact topology and its characteristic AIM/DI pattern.
items.expected: Per-contact AIM/DI values are consistent with SI Table S2 within evaluator tolerances, or a scientifically justified bounded-failure report identifies missing observables.

items.statement: The final interpretation classifies the four contacts as metallophilic and predominantly closed-shell with minor shared-shell contribution, while stating model limitations.
items.expected: Conclusion invokes |V|/G and DI evidence and does not generalize beyond the finite anion-free cluster.
